comment.body:
Thanks for preserving the native fail-fast stack and narrowing the crash to the Command Palette home page around ListItemsView item/template generation. The exact ambiguity is which home-page action or data change causes the reentrancy failure, because the report only says it happened on the home page. Please provide the smallest sequence immediately before the crash, including the visible page or extension, and reproduce it again before commenting /bugreport. This will distinguish a repeatable item-template lifecycle bug from a one-off WinUI runtime failure.

**Needed**
1. Please provide Visible home-page state and smallest action sequence; Record page, extension, and actions before crash.
2. Please provide Fresh diagnostics after reproduction; Reproduce and comment /bugreport immediately afterward.
